verdict.rationale: Poke documents its own 'Reminders' feature for setting things up naturally, and says Recipes let users 'set up automations'. That is thin, glancing support for time-triggered work that comes back to the user. The evidence never says reminders or automations run actual tasks on a recurring or one-off schedule and return results; the API triggers are event-driven, not scheduled. Missing for 10: documented recurring scheduling, one-off scheduled task execution beyond reminders, evidence that scheduled tasks run autonomously and deliver results, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule recurring or one-off tasks that run automatically and come back to me with results

citations.quote: Reminders - Set and manage reminders naturally
All new and existing users can use Poke Recipes to easily set up automations and integrations
